Original Vietnamese support-training paraphrases informed by public hotel/travel language research; no review text copied verbatim. Labels inherit validated semantic frames.

Phase-1 Vietnamese guest-style utterances manually curated and humanized for spoken colloquial diversity. Synthetic/curated, not observed guest transcripts; source_family=real remains reserved for de-identified utterances with auditable guest lineage.

Phase-1 hardened Vietnamese guest-style utterances, humanized to hide benchmark/system jargon while preserving corrections, ellipsis, negation, reference resolution, status/reopen/escalation, ASR-like text and truth-boundary behavior. Synthetic/curated, not observed guest transcripts.

Simulated guest-persona Vietnamese utterances authored to resemble real resort conversations across age, urgency, politeness, ellipsis, self-correction and light code-switching. They are synthetic/curated, not observed guest transcripts; source_family=real remains reserved for de-identified utterances with auditable guest lineage.

Simulated resort-guest utterances in English, Korean, and Chinese, authored from validated Vietnamese semantic frames with natural persona variation. Synthetic/curated, not observed guest transcripts; labels and slots are inherited from existing validated training records.
